preconditions.description: The number of rows in each level map is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The number of columns in each level map is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The number of levels is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The constant w is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(level) == n for level in levels)
preconditions.description: Each level has exactly n rows.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for level in levels for row in level)
preconditions.description: Each row in a level has exactly m columns.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell in "." + string.ascii_letters for cell in row) for level in levels for row in level)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the level maps is either a dot or a letter of the English alphabet.

postconditions.description: The first element of the output is an integer representing the minimum number of transferred bytes.
The second element of the output is a list of k pairs of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(pair, tuple) and len(pair) == 2 for pair in return_value[1])
postconditions.description: Each pair in the list consists of two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k and y in {0} | {1..k} for x, y in return_value[1])
postconditions.description: Each pair (x, y) satisfies 1 <= x <= k and y is either 0 or a previously transferred level number.

postconditions.expression: all(x == i + 1 for i, (x, y) in enumerate(return_value[1]))
postconditions.description: The first element of each pair is the level number in the order they appear in the input.
